mapper.insert: insert into review_webhook_event (provider, delivery_id, event_type, action, repository_owner, repository_name, repository_full_path, project_id, pr_number, pr_title, source_branch, target_branch, base_sha, head_sha, process_status, process_message, duplicate_count, task_id, payload_size, receive_time, process_time, create_time) values (#{provider}, #{deliveryId}, #{eventType}, #{action}, #{repositoryOwner}, #{repositoryName}, #{repositoryFullPath}, #{projectId}, #{prNumber}, #{prTitle}, #{sourceBranch}, #{targetBranch}, #{baseSha}, #{headSha}, #{processStatus}, #{processMessage}, #{duplicateCount}, #{taskId}, #{payloadSize}, #{receiveTime}, #{processTime}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select event_id, provider, delivery_id, event_type, action, repository_owner, repository_name, repository_full_path, project_id, pr_number, pr_title, source_branch, target_branch, base_sha, head_sha, process_status, process_message, duplicate_count, task_id, payload_size, receive_time, process_time from review_webhook_event where provider = #{provider} and delivery_id = #{deliveryId} limit 1
mapper.update: update review_webhook_event set duplicate_count = duplicate_count + 1, process_status = 'DUPLICATE', process_message = '重复投递，已忽略', process_time = sysdate() where provider = #{provider} and delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
